speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise; have you noticed any rash on your skin or sensitivity to bright light recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeria monocytogenes infection (Listeriosis). The patient's history of consuming unpasteurized or soft cheeses/ice cream 3 days prior, combined with fever, headache, and malaise at 30 weeks gestation, is classic for this diagnosis. Immediate treatment is required.
